editorial:
Imagine leaving your loving family for a business trip, but instead of meetings, you check into a hotel to commit the perfect crime. That is exactly what Reed does. He seems like a boring, everyday guy, but he has a dark secret and a very specific plan to kill someone. Things get wild when he hires Jackie, a call girl who is way more dangerous and unstable than he expected. The whole movie feels like a weird game of cat and mouse where you never know who is actually in control of the room.

You will love how the movie flips the script on you every few minutes. The acting is top-notch, especially the chemistry between the two leads as they try to outsmart each other. While it starts a bit slow, the twists make it worth the wait. If you like movies that keep you guessing, you should definitely check this one out. You can rent it on Apple TV or stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture quality. If you are a big movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move.
endingExplained: The ending reveals that Reed is not the only one with a dark side. After a violent struggle, Jackie proves to be just as twisted as he is. They end up in a strange kind of bond through their shared love for pain and killing. Instead of a typical ending where the bad guy goes to jail, they find a weird connection. It wraps up by showing that both characters are completely broken people who finally found someone who understands them.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological games and unexpected plot twists.
